spec: E2a follow-up (commit 0922d70e, see its fix result): JobSpec resources now carry memory_high, cpu_max and io_weight. The OCI executor reports resource limits Enforced for a request that sets only these fields, the K8s executor does not list them in inexpressible_limits (harw-job-executor-k8s/src/executor.rs ~408), and Darwin's RlimitPlan::from_request does not list them as unmapped. Fix each executor so a request with only the new fields is never reported Enforced: OCI either maps cpu_max to CpuQuota/CpuPeriod and io_weight to BlkioWeight with a read-back, or reports them Partial/NotEnforced; K8s adds them to inexpressible_limits; Darwin pushes them to unmapped. One regression test per executor. Also add `sandbox.execution` to docs/design/config-scopes.md sections 1.12 (table row: sandbox.execution | SandboxExecutionToml (chain/legacy) | None -> chain | harness_config.rs SandboxSection | ProfileReplaces via merge_sandbox), 2 (decision table: PROFILE, ProfileReplaces, untrusted project layer cannot set it) and 6.3 if it lists keys.

spec: E2c follow-up (commit after 0922d70e): OCI and K8s create_and_readback ignore the per-process rlimit fields (address_space_max, cpu_time_max, file_size_max, open_files_max) and require_rlimits, so a job with require_rlimits = true and an rlimit set runs without rlimits while resource_limits can still say Enforced. Darwin RlimitPlan::from_request maps cpu_time_max, file_size_max and open_files_max to RlimitResource::{Cpu, FileSize, OpenFiles} and lists address_space_max as unmapped. Regression tests per executor.
